title: The Border of Tashkent
author: Beatrix Villalobos
blurb: Theo Whitlock, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
